items.title: Clinical and neurophysiological determinants of response to contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation after stroke: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed the efficacy of contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) for post-stroke upper-limb rehabilitation and identified baseline motor impairment severity and corticospinal tract integrity as key modifiers of treatment effects.
items.curatedReason: 对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激 (LF-rTMS) 对卒中后上肢康复确实有效。现在，你应该更关注患者的基线运动障碍严重程度和皮质脊髓束完整性，这能帮你更好地筛选出最适合 LF-rTMS 治疗的患者，从而提升干预效果。
items.titleZh: 卒中后对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激反应的临床和神经生理学决定因素：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析证实了对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激 (LF-rTMS) 在卒中后上肢康复中的疗效，并指出基线运动障碍严重程度和皮质脊髓束完整性是治疗效果的关键调节因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis affirms the efficacy of contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) in post-stroke upper-limb rehabilitation and identifies baseline motor impairment severity and corticospinal tract integrity as key treatment effect modifiers. This guides you to consider these neurophysiological indicators when selecting rTMS interventions to enhance treatment precision and effectiveness.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析的局限性在于其结果质量受限于纳入研究的异质性和潜在发表偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of a meta-analysis is that the quality of its results is constrained by the heterogeneity and potential publication bias of the included studies.

items.title: Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale.
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated the 12-item Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale (SPAS), an activity-based PROM using a hierarchical stepwise yes/no format, with field testing on 415 patients at 12 outpatient PT centers.
items.curatedReason: 肩部疼痛功能评估又添新工具。SPAS 量表采用分层是非格式，旨在简化解读。考虑在你的诊所工作流中试用，尤其是对那些现有 PROMs 填写困难的患者。
items.titleZh: 肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS) 的开发与心理测量学验证
items.summaryZh: 研究人员开发并验证了 12 项肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS)，该量表是一种基于活动的患者报告结局量表，采用分层是非格式，并在 12 个门诊物理治疗中心的 415 名患者中进行了现场测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: A new tool for shoulder pain assessment, the SPAS scale, uses a hierarchical yes/no format to simplify interpretation. Consider piloting it in your clinical workflow, especially for patients who struggle with existing PROMs.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告患者访谈和专家评审的具体方法学细节，可能影响量表开发的透明度。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report detailed methodological specifics for patient interviews and expert reviews, which may affect the transparency of scale development.

items.title: Arm exercise training in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesizing six databases up to May 2026 concluded that arm exercise training is a valuable component of pulmonary rehabilitation for COPD patients, addressing extrapulmonary features and skeletal muscle dysfunction.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述强化了手臂运动训练在 COPD 肺康复中的证据基础。你可以更有信心地将手臂训练纳入你的 COPD 患者康复计划，以改善其肺外表现，作为整体肺康复的重要组成部分。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者手臂运动训练：系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项汇总了截至 2026 年 5 月的六个数据库的伞形综述得出结论，手臂运动训练是 COPD 患者肺康复的重要组成部分，有助于改善肺外表现和骨骼肌功能障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strengthens the evidence for arm exercise training in COPD pulmonary rehabilitation. You can more confidently integrate arm training into your COPD patient rehab plans to improve extrapulmonary manifestations as a vital component of overall pulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 伞形综述的局限性在于其结果受限于纳入的系统综述和荟萃分析的质量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of an umbrella review is that its results are constrained by the quality and heterogeneity of the included systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: Finger-worn accelerometers provided a valid and sensitive alternative to wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb performance in 20 stroke survivors with mild-to-moderate impairment, offering a more comprehensive assessment.
items.curatedReason: 指戴式加速计作为腕戴式设备的替代方案，在卒中患者上肢功能评估中展现出有效性和敏感性。这提示你，未来在远程监测或日常活动评估中，指戴设备可能提供更精细的运动数据，从而优化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 不止是手臂运动：指戴式加速计在测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢表现方面提供了一种有效且敏感的腕戴式加速计替代方案
items.summaryZh: 指戴式加速计在测量 20 名轻中度上肢损伤卒中幸存者的真实世界中上肢表现方面，提供了一种有效且敏感的腕戴式加速计替代方案，提供了更全面的评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: Finger-worn accelerometers show validity and sensitivity as an alternative to wrist-worn devices for assessing upper-limb function in stroke survivors. This suggests that in future remote monitoring or daily activity assessments, finger-worn devices might provide finer motor data, optimizing rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究设计为横断面观察性，不能建立因果关系，且样本量较小（20名卒中幸存者），限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional observational design cannot establish causality, and the small sample size (20 stroke survivors) limits the generalizability of the results.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper argues that physiotherapy, like other health professions, is entering a post-professional era driven by the commodification of health, unbundling of professional claims, and digitally mediated technological disruption, potentially marginalizing practitioners.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章触及了物理治疗专业在算法和数字化时代可能面临的“后专业化”挑战。它提醒你，在技术重塑医疗服务模式的背景下，需要重新思考 PT 的核心价值和执业模式，以应对潜在的边缘化风险。
items.titleZh: 当算法无情：物理治疗与后专业化转向
items.summaryZh: 本文认为，物理治疗与更广泛的医疗专业一样，正进入一个“后专业化”时代，其驱动力是健康商品化、专业主张的解绑以及数字化技术颠覆，这可能导致从业者被边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article addresses the potential 'post-professional' challenges facing physical therapy in the age of algorithms and digitalization. It reminds you to reconsider PT's core values and practice models in the context of technology reshaping healthcare delivery, to mitigate the risk of marginalization.

items.title: Therapeutic Exercise Protocol During Hospitalization in Pediatric Oncohematological Patients: Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 30 pediatric oncohematological patients (8-17 years) found that a therapeutic exercise program during hospitalization positively impacted muscle strength and fatigue compared to minimal physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，住院期间早期治疗性运动对肿瘤患儿的肌肉力量和疲劳有积极影响。这支持你在儿童肿瘤患者的住院康复中，更积极地推行运动干预，可能有助于改善生活质量和功能。
items.titleZh: 住院血液肿瘤患儿的治疗性运动方案：随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名 8-17 岁住院血液肿瘤患儿的随机临床试验发现，住院期间的治疗性运动方案对肌肉力量和疲劳有积极影响，优于最小活动物理治疗对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that early therapeutic exercise during hospitalization has positive effects on muscle strength and fatigue in pediatric oncology patients. This supports a more proactive approach to exercise interventions in the inpatient rehabilitation of pediatric oncology patients, potentially improving quality of life and function.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（30 名参与者），可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (30 participants) may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Neuralgic Amyotrophy Following Rotator Cuff Repair: A Patient's Experience.
items.summary: This case report describes a 64-year-old male who developed severe neuralgic amyotrophy 8 days after rotator cuff repair, achieving substantial functional recovery over one year with prolonged, progressive physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖修复术后出现臂丛神经炎相对罕见但会严重影响功能。本病例报告提示即便出现此类并发症，长期强化物理治疗仍能带来显著的功能恢复。遇到类似情况，维持患者治疗依从性至关重要。
items.titleZh: 肩袖修复术后臂丛神经炎：一例患者的经验
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 64 岁男性在肩袖修复术后 8 天出现严重臂丛神经炎，通过长期渐进式物理治疗，在一年内实现了显著的功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Neuralgic amyotrophy after rotator cuff repair is rare but can severely impact function. This case report suggests that even with such complications, prolonged intensive physical therapy can lead to significant functional recovery. Maintaining patient adherence is crucial in similar situations.
items.limitation: 作为单例病例报告，本研究的发现不具有普遍性，无法推断至其他患者群体。
items.limitationEn: As a single case report, the findings of this study are not generalizable and cannot be extrapolated to other patient populations.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A 51-year-old woman undergoing integrated rehabilitation, including aquatic therapy, after PCL reconstruction, showed improvements in knee pain, range of motion, and functional activities, highlighting aquatic therapy's potential for early recovery.
items.curatedReason: PCL 重建术后康复具有挑战性，水疗可能提供一种低负荷的早期康复环境。虽然本案例展示了水疗的积极效果，但请记住这仅是孤立的病例报告，在常规引入前仍需更多高级别证据。
items.titleZh: 后交叉韧带重建术后结合水疗的综合康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名 51 岁女性在后交叉韧带重建术后接受了包括水疗在内的综合康复，膝关节疼痛、活动范围和功能活动均有所改善，凸显了水疗在早期康复中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: PCL reconstruction rehabilitation is challenging, and aquatic therapy might offer a low-load environment for early recovery. While this case shows positive effects, remember it's an isolated case report; more high-level evidence is needed before routine implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，其结果不具备普遍性，不能作为临床决策的强证据。
items.limitationEn: This study is a single case report, and its findings are not generalizable and cannot serve as strong evidence for clinical decision-making.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of exercise-based prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis compared the effectiveness of various exercise-based prehabilitation modalities before total knee arthroplasty, aiming to clarify optimal approaches.
items.curatedReason: 这份高分的系统综述及网络Meta分析是TKA术前康复方案设计的决定性证据：告诉你在多种运动干预中，哪种效果更优。以后给TKA患者做术前康复，就按这个来。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术前运动康复的比较效果：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和网络Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络Meta分析比较了全膝关节置换术前不同运动康复模式的有效性，旨在明确最佳干预方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-scoring systematic review and network meta-analysis is definitive evidence for designing TKA prehabilitation protocols, showing which exercise interventions are more effective. Follow this guidance for TKA prehab from now on.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体运动模式下的效果量，且缺乏对术后长期结局的分析。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report effect sizes for specific exercise modalities and lacked analysis of long-term postoperative outcomes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Differences in the Thoracolumbar Fascia Between Low Back Pain Patients and Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed differences in thoracolumbar fascia characteristics between low back pain patients and healthy individuals, highlighting its potential role in LBP.
items.curatedReason: 该Meta分析确认了腰骶筋膜（TLF）在腰痛患者和健康个体之间存在结构和功能差异，支持TLF在腰痛中的力学和伤害感受作用。这强化了您在评估和治疗腰痛时，应将TLF作为重要关注点，整合筋膜手法和运动控制训练。
items.titleZh: 腰痛患者与健康个体腰骶筋膜的差异：一项系统综述与Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与Meta分析证实，腰痛患者与健康个体在腰骶筋膜特征上存在差异，提示其在腰痛中的潜在作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis confirms structural and functional differences in the thoracolumbar fascia (TLF) between low back pain patients and healthy individuals, supporting TLF's mechanical and nociceptive role in LBP. This reinforces that you should consider TLF a key focus in assessing and treating LBP, integrating fascial manipulation and motor control training.
items.limitation: 不同研究中TLF特征的测量方法和报告结果存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: There was heterogeneity in the measurement methods and reported outcomes of TLF characteristics across different studies.

items.title: Effects of tDCS combined with unstable resistance training on knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with unstable resistance training improved knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合不稳定抗阻训练能提升老年人的膝关节肌力和神经肌肉控制。这提示您在老年康复中可考虑将tDCS作为辅助手段，与功能性训练结合，以期获得更好的膝关节功能改善。
items.titleZh: tDCS联合不稳定抗阻训练对社区老年人膝关节肌力和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合不稳定抗阻训练能提升社区老年人的膝关节肌力和神经肌肉控制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that tDCS combined with unstable resistance training improved knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in older adults. This suggests you could consider tDCS as an adjunct to functional training in geriatric rehabilitation for potentially better knee function outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注社区老年人，结果外推到其他老年人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study focused solely on community-dwelling older adults, so results should be cautiously generalized to other older populations.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Vancomycin-Soaked Quadriceps Grafts Linked to Early Resorption in ACLR: study
items.summary: A study suggests that vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts are linked to early resorption following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收有关。这直接影响您在评估和管理ACL重建术后患者时，对移植物稳定性和并发症的预期和监测，尤其是在有药物浸泡史的病例中。
items.titleZh: 研究：万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收相关
items.summaryZh: 一项研究提示，万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与前交叉韧带重建术后的早期吸收有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a link between vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts and early resorption after ACLR. This directly impacts your expectations and monitoring of graft stability and complications when evaluating and managing post-ACLR patients, especially those with a history of soaked grafts.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体细节（如样本量、研究设计），因此结论需谨慎对待。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific details of the original study (e.g., sample size, study design), so conclusions should be treated with caution.

items.title: Repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns in amateur soccer players
items.summary: A study investigated repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across various movement patterns in amateur soccer players.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应有差异。你在设计训练方案时，要考虑这些模式差异，但本研究无法告诉你如何优化。
items.titleZh: 业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应
items.summaryZh: 一项研究考察了业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests amateur soccer players show varied repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns. When designing training, consider these pattern differences, but this study doesn't tell you how to optimize.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于业余足球运动员，结果在专业运动员中可能存在差异。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to amateur soccer players; results may differ for professional athletes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Federated learning for privacy-preserving collaborative health risk classification using wearable sensor data: validation study with elite football training load monitoring
items.summary: A validation study demonstrated federated learning's ability to classify health risks using wearable sensor data from elite football players while preserving privacy.
items.curatedReason: 这项验证研究展示了联邦学习在保护精英足球运动员可穿戴传感器数据隐私的同时，进行健康风险分类的潜力。这有助于您在应用技术监控高水平运动员训练负荷时，平衡数据利用与隐私保护的需求。
items.titleZh: 联邦学习在精英足球训练负荷监测中应用于隐私保护协作健康风险分类的验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项验证研究表明，联邦学习能够在使用可穿戴传感器数据监测精英足球运动员训练负荷时，在保护隐私的前提下进行健康风险分类。
items.curatedReasonEn: This validation study demonstrates the potential of federated learning for privacy-preserving health risk classification using wearable sensor data in elite football players. This helps you balance data utilization with privacy protection when applying technology to monitor training loads in high-level athletes.
items.limitation: 研究的重点在于技术验证，并未直接评估其对临床决策或康复干预的实际影响。
items.limitationEn: The study focuses on technical validation and does not directly assess its practical impact on clinical decision-making or rehabilitation interventions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes
items.summary: A study found that visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation (SmO2) are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes.
items.curatedReason: 研究明确指出，别再用视觉判定的SmO2断点代替通气阈值来评估国家级铁人三项运动员的运动强度了，它们并不等同。评估时，继续使用多种生理指标进行交叉验证。
items.titleZh: 国家级铁人三项运动员肌肉氧饱和度视觉断点与通气阈值不等同
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，国家级铁人三项运动员的肌肉氧饱和度（SmO2）视觉断点与通气阈值不等同。
items.curatedReasonEn: The study clearly states: stop using visually identified SmO2 breakpoints as a proxy for ventilatory thresholds to assess exercise intensity in national-level triathletes; they are not equivalent. Continue cross-referencing with multiple physiological indicators during assessment.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于国家级铁人三项运动员，结果在其他人群或运动类型中可能不同。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to national-level triathletes, and results may differ in other populations or sport types.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $144 million to Improve Mental Health, Substance Abuse, Emergency and Maternal Care and Expand the Healthcare Workforce in Alabama
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $144 million allocation to enhance mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama.
items.curatedReason: 美国特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。这笔资金可能影响当地PT的转诊网络和与其他医疗专业人员的协作。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元改善阿拉巴马州医疗健康服务并扩大医护队伍
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元，用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Trump Administration announced $144 million to improve mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama. This funding could impact local PT referral networks and collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

items.title: Does surgical approach or preoperative deformity better predict outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures? A comparative study of minimally invasive versus open techniques
items.summary: A comparative study investigated whether surgical approach or preoperative deformity better predicts outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures treated with minimally invasive versus open techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，胸腰椎骨折患者的术前畸形程度可能比手术方式更能预测预后。作为物理治疗师，这让你在患者术后康复时，多关注他们术前畸形的程度，而不是手术切口大小。
items.titleZh: 手术入路或术前畸形，哪个能更好地预测胸腰椎骨折的结局？微创与开放技术的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较研究探讨了在胸腰椎骨折治疗中，手术入路或术前畸形哪个能更好地预测微创与开放技术治疗后的结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests preoperative deformity may be a better predictor of outcomes than surgical approach for thoracolumbar fractures. As a physical therapist, this means focusing more on the degree of preoperative deformity in your patients' post-op rehab, rather than incision size.
items.limitation: 研究的结局指标主要集中在外科预后，对物理治疗相关的功能性恢复结局未详细阐述。
items.limitationEn: The study's outcome measures primarily focused on surgical prognosis, with less detailed elaboration on functional recovery outcomes relevant to physical therapy.

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary examines how various care process factors, such as timing of care, point of entry, care pathway design, and insurance models, significantly influence patient outcomes in low back pain management, independent of specific treatment interventions.
items.curatedReason: 理解影响腰痛物理治疗效果的因素，不仅要看治疗本身，更要关注患者接受护理的流程设计、时间节点和支付模式。这些“护理过程因素”对患者结局影响重大，是你改善执业模式时需要考虑的关键维度。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理过程因素如何塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了护理过程因素（如护理时机、起始提供者、护理路径设计和保险模式）如何在不依赖具体治疗干预的情况下，显著影响腰痛管理中的患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Beyond just the treatment, factors like care process design, timing, and payment models significantly shape outcomes in low back pain physical therapy. These 'care process factors' are crucial for you to consider when optimizing your practice model and patient pathways.

items.title: Intensive, Multi-Technology Rehabilitation Programme for Chronic Stroke Survivors: Outcomes of a Phase I Single-Arm Repeated-Measures Study.
items.summary: A Phase I single-arm study found that an 8-week, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program led to observed improvements in motor recovery for chronic stroke survivors with persistent motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 对慢性卒中患者来说，这类为期 8 周、结合多技术和小组形式的康复计划可能有助于运动功能恢复。尽管只是初步的 I 期观察研究，但它提示我们，在卒中长期康复中，整合多种技术和集体治疗模式值得探索。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者的密集多技术康复项目：I 期单臂重复测量研究结果
items.summaryZh: 一项 I 期单臂研究显示，为期 8 周的、基于小组的、结合多种技术的康复项目，使持续存在运动障碍的慢性卒中幸存者的运动功能得到改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic stroke survivors, an 8-week, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program appears promising for motor recovery. While this is only a preliminary Phase I observational study, it suggests that integrating diverse technologies and a group setting merits further investigation in long-term stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 单臂研究设计限制了其因果推断能力，且样本量未明确。
items.limitationEn: The single-arm study design limits its causal inference capabilities, and the sample size was not explicitly stated.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: A qualitative inquiry into the environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists.
items.summary: A qualitative inquiry explored environmental barriers and facilitators influencing Canadian physiotherapists' adherence to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guidelines, identifying key factors across public and private sectors using the Theoretical Domains Framework and Ecological Systems Theory.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了加拿大物理治疗师在非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性方面面临的环境障碍和促进因素。了解这些因素有助于优化指南实施策略，提升你在腰痛管理中的临床依从性。
items.titleZh: 加拿大物理治疗师非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性的环境障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响加拿大物理治疗师依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南的环境障碍和促进因素，通过理论领域框架和生态系统理论识别了公共和私营部门的关键因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists. Understanding these factors can help optimize guideline implementation strategies and improve your clinical adherence in LBP management.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，其发现的普遍性和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study, and the generalizability and external validity of its findings are limited.

items.title: Outcome measures used in studies of vestibular rehabilitation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and mapped outcome measures used in studies evaluating vestibular rehabilitation for adults with stroke, systematically searching MEDLINE, Embase, and PEDro to categorize and rank the frequency of their use.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述清晰展现了卒中后前庭康复研究中，我们最常用的评估工具是什么。在你设计临床路径或研究方案时，优先考虑这些被广泛接受的结局指标，能更好地与现有证据对话。
items.titleZh: 卒中后前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并梳理了卒中成人前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量指标，系统搜索了MEDLINE、Embase和PEDro数据库以进行分类和频率排序。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review clearly outlines the most frequently used outcome measures in post-stroke vestibular rehabilitation research. When designing your clinical pathways or research protocols, prioritizing these widely accepted measures will allow for better engagement with existing evidence.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质限制了其对结局测量工具有效性或质量的深入评估。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review limits its ability to deeply assess the validity or quality of outcome measurement tools.

items.title: Beyond Conventional Therapy in Parkinson's Disease Patients: The Impact of Visual Feedback Training on Balance and Trunk Control - A Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=21) showed that a 4-week program combining visual feedback training with conventional physiotherapy improved balance, mobility, and functional independence in Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn and Yahr stages 1-3).
items.curatedReason: 对于帕金森病患者，视觉反馈训练与传统物理治疗结合，在改善平衡和躯干控制方面显示出良好前景。你可以考虑将其作为现有治疗方案的补充。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者超越传统疗法：视觉反馈训练对平衡和躯干控制的影响——一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=21）显示，为期四周的视觉反馈训练与传统物理治疗相结合的方案，改善了帕金森病（Hoehn-Yahr 1-3期）患者的平衡、活动能力和功能独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Visual feedback training combined with conventional physiotherapy shows promise in improving balance and trunk control for Parkinson's disease patients. Consider this as a valuable adjunct to existing treatment protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性队列研究，样本量小（n=21），且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或其他混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective cohort study with a small sample size (n=21) and lacked a control group, preventing the exclusion of placebo effects or other confounding factors.

items.title: Efficacy of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation in Acute Ischemic Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Stimulation Montages and Timing.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 RCTs (419 participants) found active transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) significantly reduced neurological deficits in acute ischemic stroke (WMD=-0.86, 95% CI: -1.38 to -0.34, P=0.001) compared to sham, though no significant improvement in motor function or functional independence was observed.
items.curatedReason: 对于急性缺血性卒中，tDCS 确实在早期能显著改善神经功能缺损，这有 10 项 RCT 的证据支持。但要注意，它对运动功能或功能独立性的改善尚无显著效果，切勿向患者夸大 tDCS 在这方面的疗效。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激在急性缺血性卒中中的疗效：刺激模式和时机的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 10 项 RCT（419 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与假刺激相比，主动经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）能显著减少急性缺血性卒中患者的神经功能缺损（WMD=-0.86, 95% CI: -1.38 to -0.34, P=0.001），但未观察到运动功能或功能独立性的显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For acute ischemic stroke, tDCS significantly reduces neurological deficits in the early phase, supported by evidence from 10 RCTs. However, be aware that it shows no significant improvement in motor function or functional independence; do not overstate tDCS efficacy in these areas to patients.
items.limitation: 纳入 RCT 的样本量普遍较小，且对上肢、下肢运动功能和功能独立性的改善尚无显著证据。
items.limitationEn: The included RCTs generally had small sample sizes, and significant evidence for improvements in upper limb, lower limb motor function, and functional independence is still lacking.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Measurement properties of a 300-m community-based walking test incorporating environmental walking demands in individuals with subacute stroke.
items.summary: A retrospective analysis of 26 individuals with subacute stroke found the 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) to have good test-retest reliability (ICC 2,1) and other measurement properties, suggesting its utility in assessing environmental walking demands.
items.curatedReason: 对亚急性卒中患者，300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）现在有了更多证据支持其信效度，是一个评估真实环境步行需求的可行工具。虽然是回顾性研究，但它直接模拟了社区步行场景，这一点值得肯定。
items.titleZh: 结合环境步行需求的 300 米社区步行测试在亚急性卒中患者中的测量特性
items.summaryZh: 一项对 26 名亚急性卒中患者的回顾性分析发现，300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）具有良好的重测信度（ICC 2,1）及其他测量特性，提示其在评估环境步行需求方面的实用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For subacute stroke patients, the 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) now has more evidence supporting its reliability and validity, making it a viable tool for assessing real-world environmental walking demands. While a retrospective study, its direct simulation of community walking scenarios is a strong point.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性分析，样本量较小（26 人），且仅评估了亚急性卒中人群。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective analysis with a small sample size (26 individuals) and only evaluated individuals with subacute stroke.

items.title: Post-stroke smoking and mental health burden: sex-specific analysis of NHIS 2019-2023.
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of NHIS data (2019-2023, N=150,220 adults) found that mental health burden and smoking are common after stroke, with sex-stratified associations impacting rehabilitation outcomes and secondary stroke prevention.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后精神健康问题（抑郁、焦虑）和吸烟行为很常见，且与预后相关。评估这些因素有助于物理治疗师识别高风险患者，并考虑转诊进行多学科干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后吸烟与精神健康负担：2019-2023 年 NHIS 数据的性别特异性分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 2019-2023 年 NHIS 数据（N=150,220 名成人）的横断面分析显示，卒中幸存者中精神健康负担和吸烟行为普遍存在，且存在性别特异性关联，影响康复结局和二级卒中预防。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke mental health issues (depression, anxiety) and smoking are prevalent and linked to outcomes. Assessing these factors helps PTs identify high-risk patients and consider referrals for multidisciplinary interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality.

items.title: Analysis of Home-Based Rehabilitation Robotics: Lessons Learned from Nationwide Direct-to-Consumer Deployment.
items.summary: This article discusses lessons learned from nationwide direct-to-consumer deployment of home-based rehabilitation robotics for stroke survivors, highlighting their potential to address the significant supply-demand mismatch in neurorehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复机器人有望缓解卒中康复的供需不平衡。了解这些部署的经验教训，有助于你评估在家中应用康复技术的挑战与潜力。
items.titleZh: 居家康复机器人分析：全国性直达消费者部署的经验教训。
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了卒中幸存者居家康复机器人全国性直达消费者部署的经验教训，强调了其解决神经康复领域巨大供需不平衡的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based rehabilitation robotics could address the supply-demand imbalance in stroke rehabilitation. Understanding lessons from these deployments helps you evaluate the challenges and potential of applying rehab tech at home.

items.title: Inspiratory Strength Training in Pediatric Cardiac Critical Care: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (N unspecified) evaluated the feasibility and safety of inspiratory strength training (IST) in children with congenital heart disease in pediatric cardiac intensive care, finding it potentially efficacious for weaning from respiratory support.
items.curatedReason: 吸气肌力量训练（IST）在儿科心脏重症监护中的可行性和安全性研究。这提示 IST 可能有助于儿科心脏病患者的呼吸支持撤机，但作为回顾性研究，你应谨慎看待其结论，并期待未来的随机对照试验。
items.titleZh: 吸气肌力量训练在儿科心脏重症监护中的应用：一项回顾性队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（样本量未明确）评估了吸气肌力量训练（IST）在患有先天性心脏病的儿科重症监护患者中的可行性和安全性，发现其可能有助于呼吸支持的撤机。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study evaluates the feasibility and safety of inspiratory strength training (IST) in pediatric cardiac critical care. It suggests IST may aid weaning from respiratory support in pediatric cardiac patients, but as a retrospective study, you should interpret its conclusions cautiously and look for future RCTs.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective, single-center cohort study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 142 articles found that exercise interventions can have a small but positive impact on cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease, but optimal dosage remains unclear.
items.curatedReason: 对于轻中度阿尔茨海默病患者，即使是小剂量的运动也能带来认知功能的益处。不过，研究尚不能明确何为“最佳剂量”，临床实践中应谨慎选择运动强度和频率，并密切关注患者反应。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了142篇文章，发现运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者的认知功能有小幅积极影响，但最佳剂量仍不明确。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease, even low-dose exercise can yield cognitive benefits. However, the evidence does not yet clarify an 'optimal dosage,' prompting cautious selection of exercise intensity and frequency in clinical practice, with close attention to patient response.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告纳入试验的异质性或出版偏倚情况，且未能确定最佳运动剂量，可能限制了临床方案的标准化。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report heterogeneity or publication bias across included trials, and failed to determine an optimal exercise dosage, which may limit the standardization of clinical protocols.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 50 patients found that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the elastic coefficient of the dermis layer in limb oedema patients compared to 0% tension taping by day 9.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT提示，25%张力的肌内效贴可能对严重淋巴水肿的消肿有短期积极作用，特别是对真皮层的弹性系数有改善。但在纳入常规方案前，仍需更多研究验证其长期效果和适用人群。
items.titleZh: 使用剪切波弹性成像评估肌内效贴对严重超依赖性肢体水肿患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项50名患者参与的随机临床试验发现，与0%张力贴布相比，25%张力肌内效贴在第9天显著降低了肢体水肿患者真皮层的弹性系数。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that kinesiology taping at 25% tension might have a short-term positive effect on severe limb edema, particularly improving dermal elasticity. However, further research is needed to validate its long-term effects and applicable populations before routine incorporation.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（50例），随访时间短（16天），且仅评估了特定张力的肌内效贴效果，可能限制了结果的普遍性和长期临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (50 patients), short follow-up (16 days), and only evaluated a specific tension of kinesiology taping, which may limit the generalizability and long-term clinical significance of the results.

items.title: Have conflicts of interest in manual therapy trials for low back pain been transparent? A meta-epidemiological review.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological review aimed to assess the transparency of disclosed conflicts of interest (COI) in manual therapy trials for low back pain by comparing self-reported COIs with those found via external searches.
items.curatedReason: 本荟萃流行病学研究提醒你，在评估手法治疗腰痛研究的证据时，需警惕潜在的利益冲突，并注意研究披露的透明度，以免因利益冲突影响研究结果的解读。
items.titleZh: 手法治疗腰痛试验中的利益冲突是否透明？一项荟萃流行病学综述
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃流行病学综述旨在通过比较自我报告与外部发现的利益冲突，评估手法治疗腰痛试验中利益冲突披露的透明度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-epidemiological review highlights the need for caution when evaluating evidence from manual therapy trials for low back pain, urging attention to potential conflicts of interest and transparency in disclosures to avoid biased interpretations.
items.limitation: 本研究侧重于利益冲突披露的透明度，而非干预措施的临床效果，其结论主要关乎研究质量和可信度，不直接指导临床手法选择。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on the transparency of conflict of interest disclosures rather than the clinical effectiveness of interventions, and its conclusions primarily concern research quality and credibility, not direct guidance on clinical manual therapy choices.

items.title: Foot-Targeted Rehabilitation for Pronation-Related Anterior Knee Pain: A Two-Phase Case-Control Study and Single-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial of Manual Therapy Versus Neuromuscular Training Each With Augmented Low-Dye Taping.
items.summary: This two-phase study found foot-targeted manual therapy with augmented low-dye taping (MT + ALDT) and neuromuscular training with ALDT (NMT + ALDT) offered comparable short-term effectiveness to routine physiotherapy for pronation-related anterior knee pain.
items.curatedReason: 针对足部过度旋前的康复方案在治疗髌股关节疼痛上表现出与常规物理治疗相当的短期疗效。对伴有足部旋前症状的髌股关节疼痛患者，你的干预范围可扩展至足部手法治疗加低位贴扎或神经肌肉训练加低位贴扎。
items.titleZh: 足部靶向康复治疗旋前相关性前膝痛：一项两阶段病例对照研究和一项手法治疗对比神经肌肉训练（均联合增强型低位贴扎）的单盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项两阶段研究发现，针对足部的联合手法治疗与增强型低位贴扎 (MT + ALDT) 以及神经肌肉训练与 ALDT (NMT + ALDT) 针对旋前相关性前膝痛的短期疗效与常规物理治疗相当。
items.curatedReasonEn: Foot-targeted rehabilitation for pronation-related anterior knee pain demonstrates short-term effectiveness comparable to routine physical therapy. For patients with patellofemoral pain and pronated feet, your intervention options can now extend to manual therapy plus augmented low-dye taping or neuromuscular training plus augmented low-dye taping.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了短期疗效，长期效果仍需更多研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term efficacy; long-term effects require further research.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: This multicenter retrospective study in 200 women found the responsiveness, SDC, and MIC of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 (PFDI-20) following an 8-week pelvic floor muscle training program.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其语版 PFDI-20 在经过 8 周盆底肌训练后，其最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC) 已明确。这意味着，现在你可以更准确地判断土耳其患者盆底肌训练是否达到了临床有意义的改善。
items.titleZh: 盆底肌训练后土耳其版盆底困扰问卷-20 的响应性、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心回顾性研究在 200 名女性中，明确了土耳其版盆底困扰问卷-20 (PFDI-20) 在经过 8 周盆底肌训练后的响应性、最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SDC and MIC of the Turkish PFDI-20 after an 8-week pelvic floor muscle training program are now established. This means you can more accurately determine whether Turkish patients undergoing pelvic floor muscle training have achieved clinically meaningful improvements.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，可能存在选择偏倚和数据质量问题。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective study, which may be subject to selection bias and data quality issues.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: In 21 participants with subacromial pain syndrome, subacromial injection immediately increased activity in select shoulder muscles during humeral elevation, with sustained effects after 6 weeks of physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 肩峰下注射镇痛后，部分肩部肌肉活动度即刻增加，并持续到物理治疗 6 周后。这提示疼痛管理可能作为辅助手段，间接促进肩峰下疼痛综合征患者的肌肉功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 肩峰下疼痛综合征患者肩峰下注射镇痛后特定肩部肌肉活动度增加
items.summaryZh: 在 21 名肩峰下疼痛综合征患者中，肩峰下注射镇痛后，肱骨抬高时特定肩部肌肉活动度即刻增加，且在物理治疗 6 周后仍持续存在。
items.curatedReasonEn: Immediate increases in select shoulder muscle activity after subacromial injection persist through 6 weeks of physical therapy. This suggests pain management may serve as an adjunct to indirectly facilitate muscle function recovery in patients with subacromial pain syndrome.
items.limitation: 样本量较小，EMG 数据可能存在变异性或记录误差。
items.limitationEn: The sample size is small, and EMG data may have variability or recording errors.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study assessed the construct validity, test-retest reliability, SEM, and SDC of three movement-evoked pain calculation methods using performance-based tests in 111 individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 在膝骨关节炎患者中，三种运动诱发疼痛计算方法的信度和效度已得到评估，其 SEM 和 SDC 也已明确。这提示我们，评估膝骨关节炎疼痛时，可考虑这些方法来提高测量的准确性，但目前尚不改变具体的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛测量方法的可靠性与结构效度
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了 111 名膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛计算方法（基于功能表现测试）的结构效度、重测信度、测量标准误 (SEM) 和最小可检测变化 (SDC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: The reliability and validity of three movement-evoked pain calculation methods, along with their SEM and SDC, have been assessed in 111 individuals with knee osteoarthritis. This suggests these methods could improve the accuracy of pain measurement in KOA, though it doesn't immediately alter specific intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 研究设计为观察性研究的二次分析，可能存在方法学局限。
items.limitationEn: The study design is a secondary analysis of an observational study, which may have methodological limitations.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: This scoping review explored existing characteristics of classified gait pattern subgroups following stroke to clarify definitions and support individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述梳理了卒中后异常步态模式的分类特征。它为你理解不同分类体系、从而更精准地评估和干预卒中患者步态提供了背景信息。
items.titleZh: 卒中后步态模式亚组的分类特征及异常步态模式的定义：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述旨在全面探索卒中后已分类步态模式亚组的现有特征，以澄清定义并支持个体化步态训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review synthesizes classified gait pattern subgroups after stroke, offering essential context for understanding various classification systems and for more precise gait assessment and intervention in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 本综述未报告汇总的方向性结论，无法直接指导临床行动。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report a pooled directional conclusion, thus it cannot directly guide clinical action.

items.title: Direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behaviour in hospitals: A scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review synthesized direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behavior at the ward level to enhance consistency and utility for evaluating and promoting mobilization in hospital settings.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述汇总了在病房层面评估住院患者活动行为的直接观察方法。你可以参考这些方法来标准化评估流程，进而更有效地设计和推动住院患者的早期活动，提高干预的一致性。
items.titleZh: 评估住院患者活动行为的直接观察方法：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述综合了病房级别评估住院患者活动行为的直接观察方法，旨在提高医院环境中评估和促进患者活动的一致性和实用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review synthesizes direct observation methods for assessing inpatient movement behavior at the ward level. You can use these methods to standardize assessment processes, which should lead to more effective and consistent strategies for promoting early mobilization in hospitalized patients.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，它主要侧重于方法学分类而非干预效果评估。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, its primary focus is on methodological classification rather than intervention effectiveness.

items.title: The Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose for Blood Pressure Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Systematic Review with Bayesian Model-Based, and Dose-Response Network Meta-Analysis of RCTs.
items.summary: This systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis compared the effects of different exercise modalities and doses on resting systolic and diastolic BP in middle-aged and older adults (≥45 years), identifying optimal approaches for blood pressure management.
items.curatedReason: 有氧运动、阻力训练或两者结合，对中老年（≥45岁）高血压患者均有益。结合该综述的证据，你应该根据患者具体情况，推荐最适合的运动模式和剂量，以优化其血压管理。
items.titleZh: 中老年人血压管理的最佳运动方式与剂量：一项基于贝叶斯模型和剂量反应网络 Meta 分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析比较了不同运动方式和剂量对中老年人（≥45岁）静息收缩压和舒张压的影响，旨在确定血压管理的最佳方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Aerobic exercise, resistance training, or a combination of both benefits middle-aged and older adults (≥45 years) with hypertension. Based on this systematic review, tailor your exercise prescription to each patient, recommending the most suitable modality and dosage to optimize their blood pressure management.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但纳入研究的异质性可能影响结果的综合解释。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, heterogeneity among included studies may affect the comprehensive interpretation of results.

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This RCT (N=28) found that a functional physiotherapy program (pain science education, cognition-targeted exercises, relaxation) and a conventional program (TENS, pelvic floor muscle training) showed similar effects on symptoms, pain-related and psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 功能性物理治疗干预，包括疼痛科学教育和认知行为策略，在膀胱疼痛综合征患者中表现出与传统理疗（TENS、盆底肌训练）相似的效果。考虑将功能性方案作为一线选择，因为它同时改善了症状、心理结局和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗在膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者中对症状、心理结局和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（N=28）发现，针对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者，功能性物理治疗（疼痛科学教育、认知练习、放松）与传统物理治疗（TENS、盆底肌训练）在改善症状、疼痛相关及心理结局、生活质量方面效果相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional physiotherapy interventions, including pain science education and cognitive-behavioral strategies, demonstrate similar efficacy to conventional physical therapy (TENS, pelvic floor muscle training) for bladder pain syndrome. Consider functional programs as a first-line option, as they improve symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life concurrently.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=28），可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (N=28), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored experiences of postgraduate Masters physiotherapy mentees and mentors in Canada and the UK engaged in telehealth e-mentoring, identifying learning processes, perceived outcomes, and challenges.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制在骨骼肌肉物理治疗研究生教育中是可行的，并被导师和学员普遍接受。它为 PT 教育提供了跨区域、灵活的模式，但你需要留意跨文化沟通和技术障碍。
items.titleZh: 远程电子导师制在加拿大和英国骨骼肌肉物理治疗研究生教育中的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大和英国骨骼肌肉物理治疗研究生学员与导师在远程电子导师制中的经验，揭示了学习过程、感知结果和挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring is feasible and well-received by both mentors and mentees in postgraduate musculoskeletal physiotherapy education. It offers a flexible, cross-regional model for PT education, but be mindful of cross-cultural communication and technological barriers.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，未能提供量化的干预效果数据。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study, and it did not provide quantitative data on intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults: A scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review systematically mapped and characterized the methodological features of mechanically induced perturbation-based balance training (PBT) interventions in healthy older adults, identifying variability across studies.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述系统地总结了健康老年人扰动基础平衡训练（PBT）的方法学特征。在实施 PBT 预防跌倒时，你应该借鉴这些标准化方法，并注意研究间的差异性，以优化训练方案。
items.titleZh: 健康老年人扰动基础平衡训练的方法学特征：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统地梳理并描述了健康老年人机械诱导扰动基础平衡训练（PBT）的方法学特征，识别了研究间的差异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically summarizes the methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training (PBT) in healthy older adults. When implementing PBT for fall prevention, you should draw on these standardized methods and note inter-study variability to optimize training protocols.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，它主要侧重于方法学特征的映射，而非评估 PBT 的干预效果。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it primarily focused on mapping methodological features rather than evaluating the intervention's effectiveness.

items.title: Systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain: Refining the mechanistic lens.
items.summary: This article discusses systemic inflammation as a potential mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain, aiming to refine the mechanistic understanding of its effects.
items.curatedReason: 运动干预慢性下腰痛时，系统性炎症或许是一个关键调节因素。虽然这仍是述评，但它提示我们，运动的镇痛机制可能与调节炎症通路有关，值得未来研究和临床实践中加以关注。
items.titleZh: 系统性炎症作为运动干预慢性下腰痛益处的介质：机制视角的深化
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨系统性炎症作为运动干预慢性下腰痛益处的潜在介质，旨在深化对其作用机制的理解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Systemic inflammation might be a key modulator when exercising for chronic low back pain. While this is a review, it suggests that exercise's analgesic mechanism could be linked to modulating inflammatory pathways. This is worth considering in future research and clinical practice.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study using semi-structured interviews with 14 international RoCuTe patients identified 33 subthemes across three themes, revealing patients' perspectives on symptom onset, treatment outcomes, and the value of clinician listening and validation.
items.curatedReason: 患者对肩袖肌腱病管理的看法突出强调了对清晰信息和验证性倾听的需求，以及他们对运动疗法的信心。这提示我们在临床实践中，应更重视患者的体验和偏好。
items.titleZh: “我真的，真的只相信运动了”：患者对肩袖肌腱病管理的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对全球 14 名肩袖肌腱病患者进行的半结构化访谈定性研究，总结了 3 个主题下的 33 个亚主题，揭示了患者对症状发生、治疗结果以及临床医生倾听和验证的重视。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management highlight the need for clear information and validating listening, alongside their confidence in exercise therapy. This suggests prioritizing patient experience and preferences in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（N=14），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (N=14), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Impacts of ankle sprain on functional performance in under-20 soccer players: a cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study of 75 male under-20 soccer players found that those with a history of lateral ankle sprain showed impaired functional performance compared to those without, based on CAIT, FAAM, WBLT, and YBT scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 U20 足球运动员的横断面研究发现，踝关节扭伤史与功能受损相关。你在评估年轻运动员时，应高度关注踝关节扭伤史，并通过功能性测试识别风险。
items.titleZh: 踝关节扭伤对 U20 足球运动员功能表现的影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 75 名 U20 男性足球运动员的多中心横断面研究显示，有踝关节外侧扭伤史的运动员在 Cumberland 踝关节不稳工具（CAIT）、足踝能力量表（FAAM）、负重弓步测试（WBLT）和 Y 平衡测试（YBT）评分中，功能表现受损。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study in U20 soccer players found a history of ankle sprain is associated with impaired functional performance. When assessing young athletes, pay close attention to ankle sprain history and identify risks through functional tests.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study design cannot establish causality.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Current Manual Therapy Practices in Pediatric Neurological Physiotherapy: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 61 Greek physiotherapists revealed that 55.7% use Manual Therapy as an adjunct in pediatric neurological physiotherapy, primarily for joint mobility, with formal training correlating with higher perceived effectiveness for pain reduction (p=.013) and sensory processing (p=.004).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对希腊儿童神经物理治疗师的调查显示，手法治疗被广泛用作辅助干预，主要用于改善关节活动度和活动范围。你应重视手法治疗的正式培训，这与患者疼痛和感觉处理的感知效果相关。
items.titleZh: 儿科神经物理治疗中手法治疗的当前实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 61 名希腊物理治疗师的横断面调查显示，55.7% 的受访者在儿科神经物理治疗中将手法治疗作为辅助手段，主要用于改善关节活动度；正式培训与疼痛减轻（p=.013）和感觉处理（p=.004）的更高感知效果相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of Greek pediatric neurological physiotherapists shows manual therapy is widely used as an adjunct, primarily for improving joint mobility and range of motion. Prioritize formal manual therapy training, as it correlates with perceived effectiveness for pain reduction and sensory processing.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，存在回忆偏倚和自我报告偏倚，且仅限于希腊的物理治疗师。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey is subject to recall and self-report bias, and is limited to physiotherapists in Greece.

items.title: Tapering and Peaking in the Weight Lifting Sports: A Systematic Review of Athletes’ Self-Reported Strategies
items.summary: A systematic review compiles self-reported strategies used by athletes for tapering and peaking in weightlifting sports, highlighting common practices.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述总结了举重运动员在赛前减量和巅峰期的策略。你可以参考这些常见的自我报告实践，为你的举重运动员提供更个性化、更有效的赛前训练调整指导，帮助他们达到最佳竞技状态。
items.titleZh: 举重运动员赛前减量和巅峰期策略的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述收集了举重运动员在赛前减量和巅峰期策略方面的自我报告数据，强调了常见做法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review compiles self-reported strategies for tapering and peaking in weightlifting sports. You can use these common practices to offer more personalized and effective pre-competition training adjustments for your weightlifters, helping them achieve peak performance.
items.limitation: 证据来源于运动员的自我报告策略，可能存在回忆偏差和主观性，并非基于客观生理测量。
items.limitationEn: Evidence is based on athletes' self-reported strategies, which may be subject to recall bias and subjectivity, and not based on objective physiological measurements.

items.title: Rehabilitative game-based exercise integrated into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis: a pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial explores the integration of rehabilitative game-based exercise into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS), aiming to increase patient engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的 RCT 提示，游戏化运动可能提升青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）患者的依从性。尽管是小样本，你可以在临床中考虑将游戏元素融入治疗方案，以提高年轻患者的参与度和积极性。
items.titleZh: 游戏化运动与保守治疗结合改善青少年特发性脊柱侧弯：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机对照试验探讨了将游戏化康复运动整合到青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）保守治疗中的潜力，旨在提高患者依从性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that game-based exercise may improve adherence in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) patients. Even with a small sample, consider incorporating game elements into your treatment plans to boost engagement and motivation in younger patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步随机对照试验，未提供具体依从性或疗效数据，且样本量有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial without specific adherence or efficacy data, and with a limited sample size.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigates the effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease, exploring underlying biological mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，针对帕金森病患者的多学科强化门诊康复可能通过调节血浆神经丝和肌因子来产生生物学效应。这为运动在神经退行性疾病中的作用提供了新的生物标志物研究方向，但尚不能直接指导临床方案调整。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响：一项探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析研究了帕金森病患者多学科强化门诊康复计划对血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响，旨在阐明其潜在的生物学机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program for Parkinson's disease might exert biological effects by modulating plasma neurofilaments and myokines. This opens new biomarker research avenues for exercise in neurodegenerative diseases but does not yet directly inform clinical protocol adjustments.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性分析，其结果需要更大型的随机对照试验来验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory analysis, and its results require validation in larger randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Exploring Factors to Explain Interindividual Responses to Running Economy in Advanced Footwear Technology Shoes: A Randomised Crossover Laboratory Trial with an Explanatory Predictor Analysis
items.summary: A randomized crossover laboratory trial investigates factors explaining interindividual responses to running economy in advanced footwear technology shoes, with an explanatory predictor analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 揭示了高性能跑鞋对跑步经济性的个体反应差异。在为运动员提供跑鞋建议时，请记住这种差异，不要盲目推荐，而应结合个体评估和反馈。
items.titleZh: 高性能跑鞋对跑步经济性的个体反应差异及其解释因素：一项随机交叉实验室试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉实验室试验，通过解释性预测因子分析，探索了高性能跑鞋在提高跑步经济性方面个体反应差异的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT highlights individual differences in running economy responses to advanced footwear. When advising athletes on shoes, remember this variability; avoid blanket recommendations and instead integrate individual assessments and feedback.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且是在实验室环境下进行，其结果在实际跑动场景中的普适性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and it was conducted in a laboratory setting, so the generalizability of its findings to real-world running scenarios needs further validation.

items.title: Assessing concerns about falling: a comparison of telephone-based and face-to-face FES-I interviews in older adults
items.summary: A study comparing telephone-based and face-to-face interviews for assessing concerns about falling (FES-I) in older adults found comparable results, supporting remote assessment methods.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，电话访谈和面对面访谈在评估老年人跌倒担忧（FES-I）方面效果相当。这意味着你在远程医疗中可以放心地使用电话访谈，这为老年患者的跌倒风险评估提供了便利且有效的途径。
items.titleZh: 电话与面对面访谈评估老年人跌倒担忧的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较电话和面对面访谈评估老年人跌倒担忧（FES-I）的研究发现结果具有可比性，支持远程评估方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that telephone and face-to-face interviews are comparable for assessing concerns about falling (FES-I) in older adults. This means you can confidently use telephone interviews in telehealth, providing a convenient and effective way to assess fall risk for elderly patients.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提供参与者的基线特征和具体评估工具的信效度数据，可能影响结果的泛化性。
items.limitationEn: The study does not explicitly provide baseline characteristics of participants or specific reliability and validity data for the assessment tools, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation on muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity and their relationship with balance in older adults with a history of falls
items.summary: This study investigates the effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) on muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity, and balance in older adults with a history of falls.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究表明，高清经颅直流电刺激（HD-tDCS）可能对有跌倒史老年人的肌肉力量、本体感觉、皮肤敏感度及平衡产生积极影响。你可以将其视为一种潜在的辅助干预手段，但目前尚不足以作为常规推荐，仍需更高级别的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 高清经颅直流电刺激对有跌倒史老年人肌肉力量、本体感觉、皮肤敏感度及其与平衡关系的影响
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在调查高清经颅直流电刺激（HD-tDCS）对有跌倒史老年人的肌肉力量、本体感觉、皮肤敏感度及其与平衡能力之间关系的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study indicates that High-Definition Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (HD-tDCS) may positively affect muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity, and balance in older adults with a history of falls. You can consider it a potential adjunctive intervention, but it's not yet ready for routine recommendation; higher-level evidence is needed.
items.limitation: 研究设计未明确说明，且结论来自对多项生理指标的探索性分析，需要更明确的对照试验验证。
items.limitationEn: The study design is not clearly specified, and conclusions are derived from an exploratory analysis of multiple physiological parameters, requiring more definitive controlled trials for validation.

items.title: Unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults
items.summary: Unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults, according to a recent study.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，不稳平面深蹲与较低的姿势稳定性指数相关，但在健康年轻人中未发现肢间晃动不对称。这意味着在训练中引入不稳平面可能有效挑战姿势控制，但对不对称性的影响仍需进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 不稳平面深蹲与健康年轻人姿势稳定性下降相关，但与肢间晃动不对称无关
items.summaryZh: 一项最新研究显示，不稳平面深蹲与健康年轻人的姿势稳定性指数下降有关，但与肢间晃动不对称性无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults. This suggests that introducing unstable surfaces in training may effectively challenge postural control, but its impact on asymmetry requires further investigation.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了急性反应，长期训练效果和机制需要更多纵向研究。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed acute responses, and the long-term training effects and mechanisms require more longitudinal research.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients: a retrospective cross-sectional study
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study finds a relationship between the uric acid to prealbumin ratio and frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性观察研究提示，尿酸与前白蛋白比值可能与老年门诊患者的衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险相关。你可以考虑在临床筛查中关注这一比值，作为早期识别高风险老年患者的潜在生物标志物。
items.titleZh: 尿酸与前白蛋白比值与老年门诊患者衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险的关系：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性横断面研究发现，尿酸与前白蛋白比值与老年门诊患者的衰弱、肌肉力量和营养不良风险之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective observational study suggests that the uric acid to prealbumin ratio may be linked to frailty, muscle strength, and malnutrition risk in older geriatric outpatients. You could consider monitoring this ratio in clinical screening as a potential biomarker for early identification of high-risk elderly patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受限于特定门诊人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cross-sectional study, so it cannot establish causality, and the results may be limited to a specific outpatient population.

items.title: Opioids Do Not Relieve Persistent  Breathlessness among COPD patients,  suggests study
items.summary: A study suggests that opioids do not relieve persistent breathlessness among COPD patients, highlighting the need for alternative interventions.

items.titleZh: 研究提示阿片类药物无法缓解 COPD 患者持续性呼吸困难

items.title: Mepivacaine Provides Greater Short-Term Relief Than Dry Needling and Local Lidocaine for Myofascial Pain: Study
items.summary: A study comparing mepivacaine, dry needling, and local lidocaine for myofascial pain found that mepivacaine provided greater short-term relief.

items.summary: A clinical prediction rule was developed using the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Centre dataset (2607 patients) to predict independent walking one year after traumatic SCI, identifying grade-specific predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这个基于大样本数据集开发的临床预测规则，能根据 ASIA 损伤分级为创伤性脊髓损伤患者提供一年后独立步行的差异化预后，对于制定康复计划和管理患者期望很有价值。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后独立行走的等级特异性临床预测规则
items.summaryZh: 一项研究利用全国脊髓损伤统计中心数据集（2607 名患者）开发了一个临床预测规则，旨在预测创伤性脊髓损伤患者一年后的独立行走能力，并识别了与损伤等级相关的预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical prediction rule, developed using a large dataset, provides differentiated prognosis for independent walking one year after traumatic spinal cord injury based on ASIA Impairment Scale grades, valuable for rehabilitation planning and managing patient expectations.
items.limitation: 预测变量的选择和机器学习模型建立的细节需进一步公开，以评估其稳健性和可解释性。
items.limitationEn: Further details on the selection of predictive variables and the establishment of machine learning models are needed to assess robustness and interpretability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury

items.title: Associations of Walk-and-Turn Spatiotemporal Gait Parameters With Functional Mobility in Children With Cerebral Palsy at GMFCS Levels I and II
items.summary: Spatiotemporal gait parameters during a 5-meter walk-and-turn task, alongside lower extremity muscle strength and limitations of motion, are associated with functional mobility and Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS) level in ambulatory children with cerebral palsy at GMFCS Levels I and II.
items.curatedReason: 在评估 GMFCS I 和 II 级脑瘫患儿时，除了常规步态分析，别忘了 5 米折返走任务中的时空步态参数。这些参数与患儿的活动能力和 GMFCS 分级有明确关联，提示你应更全面地考虑评估维度，尤其要关注肌肉力量和关节活动度。
items.titleZh: 行走-转身时空步态参数与脑瘫儿童功能移动能力的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，在 GMFCS I 和 II 级的行走能力脑瘫儿童中，5 米行走-转身任务中的时空步态参数、下肢肌力和运动受限与功能移动能力及 GMFCS 等级相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing GMFCS I and II children with CP, go beyond standard gait analysis. Spatiotemporal gait parameters during a 5-meter walk-and-turn task, alongside lower extremity muscle strength and ROM, are linked to their functional mobility and GMFCS level. This suggests we should consider these broader assessment dimensions.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注 GMFCS I 和 II 级儿童，结果不适用于更重症的脑瘫患者。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on GMFCS Levels I and II children, so the results may not be applicable to more severely affected CP patients.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Protective Techniques and Postural Strategies for Individuals With Blindness or Low Vision: A Guide for Clinicians and Patients
items.summary: A guide for clinicians and patients outlines protective techniques and postural strategies for individuals with blindness or low vision, focusing on preventing injuries to the head, face, or upper body, which are not fully addressed by mobility aids.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床指南为盲人或低视力个体提供了保护性技术和姿势策略，尤其强调了头部和上半身损伤的预防。在处理这类患者时，你应将这些策略整合到你的步态和平衡训练中，以降低跌倒及碰撞风险。
items.titleZh: 盲人或低视力个体保护技术和姿势策略：临床医师与患者指南
items.summaryZh: 一份为临床医师和患者提供的指南，概述了盲人或低视力个体的保护性技术和姿势策略，旨在预防头部、面部或上半身损伤，因为这些损伤通常无法通过助行器完全避免。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical guide offers protective techniques and postural strategies for individuals with blindness or low vision, with a particular emphasis on preventing head and upper-body injuries. When treating these patients, you should integrate these strategies into your gait and balance training to reduce the risk of falls and collisions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Switzerland: the European crossroad of sports eligibility decision-making in athletes with cardiovascular conditions
items.summary: The approach to sports eligibility for athletes with cardiovascular conditions is evolving from a clinician-centric, safety-first model to one that integrates patient autonomy, reflecting a broader shift in medical ethics.
items.curatedReason: 评估运动员心血管疾病运动资格的决策模式正在从家长式（强调风险最小化）向患者自主（整合患者声音）转变。了解这一范式转变，有助于你平衡运动员健康安全与自主选择。
items.titleZh: 瑞士：欧洲运动员心血管疾病运动资格决策的交叉点
items.summaryZh: 运动员心血管疾病运动资格的决策模式正从以临床医生为中心、安全优先的模式，向整合患者自主性的模式转变，反映了医学伦理的更广泛转变。
items.curatedReasonEn: The decision-making paradigm for athletes with cardiovascular conditions is shifting from paternalistic (risk minimization) to patient-centered (integrating patient autonomy). Understand this shift to better balance athlete safety with their self-determination.

items.title: Infographic. Active commuting is linked to lower coronary atherosclerosis
items.summary: An infographic summarizes research linking active commuting (walking or cycling to work) to lower coronary atherosclerosis, suggesting it's a practical way to integrate physical activity into daily routines.
items.curatedReason: 这项信息图总结的研究表明，主动通勤与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化风险相关。你可以向患者推荐步行或骑自行车通勤，作为增加日常活动量、改善心血管健康的实用策略。
items.titleZh: 信息图：主动通勤与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化风险相关
items.summaryZh: 一份信息图总结的研究表明，主动通勤（步行或骑自行车上班）与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化风险相关，提示这是一种将体育活动融入日常生活的实用方式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This infographic summarizes research showing active commuting is linked to a lower risk of coronary atherosclerosis. You can recommend walking or cycling to work as a practical strategy for patients to increase daily activity and improve cardiovascular health.

items.title: How occupational therapists integrate robotic therapy into routine practice: a qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored how occupational therapists in Bangkok, Thailand, integrate robotic hand exoskeleton therapy into routine stroke rehabilitation, identifying five themes including client readiness and motivation for robotic use.
items.curatedReason: 将机器人手部外骨骼疗法引入卒中康复，需要重点关注患者的准备度和动机，这直接影响治疗成效。本研究揭示了泰国OT在此方面的实践经验，值得我们思考如何在不同文化背景下有效筛选和准备患者。
items.titleZh: 职业治疗师如何将机器人疗法整合到常规实践中：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了泰国曼谷的职业治疗师如何将机器人手部外骨骼疗法整合到常规卒中康复实践中，归纳出五个主题，包括患者使用机器人的准备度和动机。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating robotic hand exoskeleton therapy into stroke rehab demands careful consideration of client readiness and motivation, as this directly impacts treatment outcomes. This study from Thailand highlights practical considerations from OTs, prompting us to reflect on effective patient selection and preparation across diverse cultural contexts.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，且仅在泰国曼谷两家机构进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and was conducted in only two occupational therapy services in Bangkok, Thailand, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Associations of motor recovery and perceived social support with participation-related outcomes in chronic stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 40 chronic stroke survivors and 41 healthy controls examined associations of motor recovery and perceived social support with participation-related outcomes, including life satisfaction and health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，卒中患者的运动恢复和社会支持水平共同影响其参与度相关结局。在制定干预计划时，除了关注运动功能，别忘了评估和提升患者的社会支持。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中患者运动恢复和社会支持与参与度相关结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项对 40 名慢性卒中幸存者和 41 名健康对照的横断面研究，检验了运动恢复和感知社会支持与参与度相关结局（包括生活满意度和健康相关生活质量）之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that both motor recovery and perceived social support influence participation-related outcomes in stroke patients. When designing intervention plans, remember to assess and enhance patients' social support in addition to motor function.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This study is a cross-sectional design, which precludes establishing causality, and has a relatively small sample size.

items.title: Early Emergence of Abnormal Muscle Synergies in the Human Upper Extremity Following Stroke
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 39 early subacute stroke patients (within 6 months) performing reaching movements revealed the early emergence of abnormal muscle synergies in the upper extremity, similar to patterns seen in chronic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提供了关于卒中后异常肌肉协同模式早期出现的证据。这提示你，对早期卒中患者的评估应关注这些模式，以期可能进行早期干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后人体上肢异常肌肉协同模式的早期出现
items.summaryZh: 这项对 39 名早期亚急性卒中患者（6 个月内）进行伸手动作的横断面研究显示，上肢异常肌肉协同模式在卒中后早期即出现，与慢性卒中中观察到的模式相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides evidence on the early emergence of abnormal muscle synergies post-stroke. This suggests that your assessment of early stroke patients should focus on these patterns, potentially allowing for earlier intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪异常协同模式随时间演变的过程，且结果尚未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This study is cross-sectional, unable to track the evolution of abnormal synergy patterns over time, and the results have not yet undergone peer review.

items.title: Musculoskeletal impairments associated with migraine in young adults: a case-control study.
items.summary: A case-control study of 140 university students found that migraine was associated with reduced core muscle endurance, cervical muscle endurance, and altered craniovertebral angle, even after adjusting for age, sex, and BMI.
items.curatedReason: 本项病例对照研究提示，偏头痛年轻患者普遍存在核心肌耐力、颈肌耐力下降及颅椎角异常。在临床评估偏头痛患者时，应将其作为潜在的共病因素纳入考虑，并关注其可能导致的姿势改变和肌骨功能障碍。
items.titleZh: 年轻成人偏头痛与肌肉骨骼障碍的相关性：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 140 名大学生的病例对照研究发现，偏头痛与核心肌耐力、颈肌耐力下降以及颅椎角异常相关，即使调整了年龄、性别和体重指数后，这种关联依然存在。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study suggests young adults with migraine frequently exhibit reduced core and cervical muscle endurance, along with altered craniovertebral angles. Consider these as potential comorbidities when evaluating migraine patients, focusing on associated postural changes and musculoskeletal dysfunction.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例对照设计，仅能揭示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This case-control study can only show associations and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Twenty years of the fitness and mobility exercise (FAME) program for people post-stroke: a multi-data source evaluation of implementation using the RE-AIM framework.
items.summary: A mixed-methods, multi-data source study using the RE-AIM Framework evaluated 20 years of the Fitness and Mobility Exercise (FAME) program for stroke, finding 35 publications (49% RCTs) and international research uptake (43% outside Canada).
items.curatedReason: FAME 项目作为一项循证社区卒中康复计划，经过二十年的推广，其在全球范围内的实施和影响得到了验证。这提示我们高质量的康复项目可以通过多元化策略实现广泛传播和应用，您在社区实践中可以将其作为参考模型。
items.titleZh: 卒中后患者健身与活动度锻炼（FAME）项目实施二十年评估：基于 RE-AIM 框架的多数据源研究
items.summaryZh: 一项采用 RE-AIM 框架的混合方法、多数据源研究，评估了卒中后健身与活动度锻炼（FAME）项目实施二十年的情况，共识别出 35 篇出版物（其中 49% 为随机试验），并发现该项目在国际上获得了研究应用（43% 在加拿大以外）。
items.limitation: 本研究采用混合方法和多数据源评估，缺乏对实际临床结局的直接评估。
items.limitationEn: This mixed-methods, multi-data source evaluation lacked direct assessment of clinical outcomes.

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a randomized controlled trial of a patient-centred transition program for stroke survivors and their caregivers-P-NAVISTROKE study.
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial (n=28 stroke survivors, 9 caregivers) found a patient-centered transition program, combining an information platform and case manager follow-up, to be feasible and acceptable for stroke survivors and their caregivers during hospital-to-home transition.
items.curatedReason: P-NAVISTROKE 试验的初步结果表明，以患者为中心的卒中过渡期支持项目，结合信息平台和个案经理随访，在提高卒中幸存者及其照护者的心理社会恢复方面是可行且可接受的。这提示您未来在设计卒中康复方案时，可考虑纳入类似的多维度支持模式。
items.titleZh: 以患者为中心的卒中幸存者及其照护者过渡期项目（P-NAVISTROKE）随机对照试验的可行性与可接受性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验（28 名卒中幸存者，9 名照护者）发现，一个结合信息平台和个案经理随访的以患者为中心的过渡期项目，对于卒中幸存者及其照护者在从医院过渡到家庭期间是可行且可接受的。
items.curatedReasonEn: Initial findings from the P-NAVISTROKE trial suggest that a patient-centered stroke transition program, combining an information platform and case manager follow-up, is feasible and acceptable for improving psychosocial recovery in stroke survivors and caregivers. Consider incorporating similar multidimensional support models when designing future stroke rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本预试验性质的随机对照试验，主要评估可行性和可接受性，而非疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot RCT with a small sample size, primarily assessing feasibility and acceptability, not efficacy.

items.title: Effectiveness of Telerehabilitation Versus Conventional Rehabilitation on Motor Function and Activities of Daily Living After Stroke: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of four RCTs (N=226) found that telerehabilitation for stroke patients showed noninferiority compared to conventional rehabilitation for motor function (e.g., Fugl-Meyer change adjusted difference 0.06 points, 95% CI -2.14 to 2.26; p = .96) and activities of daily living.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复对卒中患者的运动功能和日常生活活动（ADL）非劣效于传统康复的证据正在累积。在实践中考虑将远程方案作为替代选择，特别是对于那些难以到院的患者，但仍需注意数据量相对较小。
items.titleZh: 远程康复与传统康复对卒中后运动功能和日常生活活动影响的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 4 项随机对照试验（226 名患者）的系统综述发现，卒中患者的远程康复在改善运动功能（如 Fugl-Meyer 变化调整后差异 0.06 分，95% CI -2.14 至 2.26；p = .96）和日常生活活动方面，与传统面对面康复相比具有非劣效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence is accumulating that telerehabilitation is non-inferior to conventional rehabilitation for motor function and activities of daily living (ADL) in stroke patients. Consider telerehabilitation as an alternative, especially for patients with access barriers, but remain mindful of the relatively small data volume.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入四项 RCT，总样本量 226 人，数据量相对较小，可能限制结果的精确性和普适性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only four RCTs with a total of 226 participants, which is a relatively small data volume and may limit the precision and generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effects of Fingertip Vibrotactile Stimulation on Postural Control in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Comparison Across Age Groups
items.summary: This study of 348 community-dwelling older adults (65-74, 75-84, 85+ years) found that fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improved postural control (measured by center of pressure velocity and area) across all age groups compared to no stimulation.
items.curatedReason: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人的姿势控制有改善作用，且这种效应在不同年龄组（65-74 岁、75-84 岁、85 岁以上）中持续存在。这提示了该干预作为跌倒预防策略的潜在价值，尤其适用于高龄群体。
items.titleZh: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人姿势控制的影响：不同年龄组间的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 348 名社区老年人（分为 65-74 岁、75-84 岁和 85 岁以上）的研究显示，指尖振动触觉刺激能够改善所有年龄组的姿势控制（通过足底压力中心速度和面积测量），相对于无刺激条件。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improves postural control in community-dwelling older adults, with effects consistent across various age groups (65-74, 75-84, and 85+ years). This suggests its potential value as a fall prevention strategy, particularly for the oldest-old.
items.limitation: 本研究测量的是代偿性姿势控制指标（COP 速度和面积），而非直接的跌倒发生率，且未评估长期效应。
items.limitationEn: This study measured compensatory postural control metrics (COP velocity and area) rather than direct fall incidence, and long-term effects were not assessed.

items.title: Exploring readiness to patient-centered goal-setting in stroke Rehabilitation-A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring perspectives of stroke survivors, caregivers, and physiotherapists on goal-setting in stroke rehabilitation found that goal-setting is largely clinician-led with limited patient and caregiver involvement, identifying themes related to attitudes, uncertainty, communication challenges, and health system factors.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了卒中康复中，患者和照护者在目标设定上的参与度有限，理疗师主导的现象。了解这些视角有助于反思并优化以患者为中心的目标设定流程，更有效地整合患者意愿。
items.titleZh: 探索卒中康复中以患者为中心的目标设定准备度：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究通过访谈 15 名卒中幸存者、7 名照护者和 16 名理疗师，发现卒中康复中的目标设定过程主要由临床医生主导，患者和照护者参与度有限，并揭示了影响目标设定的态度、不确定性、沟通挑战和卫生系统因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals limited patient and caregiver involvement in goal-setting during stroke rehabilitation, often remaining clinician-led. Understanding these perspectives can help optimize patient-centered goal-setting processes and better integrate patient preferences.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（15 名卒中幸存者、7 名照护者、16 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (15 stroke survivors, 7 caregivers, 16 physiotherapists), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Modest Payment Increases Finalized by CMS for SNFs and IRFs
items.summary: CMS finalized modest payment increases for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) for fiscal year 2027, with new rules expected to increase the burden on facilities for delivering, coordinating, and documenting patient care.
items.curatedReason: CMS 最终确定了 2027 财年专业护理机构（SNF）和住院康复机构（IRF）的适度支付增长。虽然增长幅度不大，但新规则增加了设施在患者护理交付、协调和文件记录方面的负担，这直接影响你在这些机构中的执业实践和工作流程。
items.titleZh: CMS 最终确定 SNF 和 IRF 的适度支付增长
items.summaryZh: CMS 最终确定了 2027 财年专业护理机构（SNF）和住院康复机构（IRF）的适度支付增长，预计新规则将增加设施在患者护理交付、协调和文件记录方面的负担。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has finalized modest payment increases for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) for FY 2027. While the increases are small, the new rules impose increased burdens on facilities for patient care delivery, coordination, and documentation, directly impacting your practice and workflow in these settings.

items.title: Effectiveness and feasibility of home-based physical exercise interventions for children and adolescents with chronic diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published up to December 2025 found home-based physical exercise interventions to be effective and feasible in improving aerobic capacity, functional capacity, muscle strength, and quality of life for children and adolescents with chronic diseases.
items.curatedReason: 对于患有慢性疾病的儿童和青少年，将运动疗法扩展到家庭环境的可行性和有效性一直是我们关注的。这项系统综述明确指出，居家体育锻炼干预能有效改善他们的有氧能力、功能、肌肉力量和生活质量。这意味着你可以更自信地向家长推荐居家运动方案，以支持这些患儿的长期康复。
items.titleZh: 居家体育锻炼干预对患慢性病儿童和青少年的有效性和可行性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项截至 2025 年 12 月的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，居家体育锻炼干预对患慢性病的儿童和青少年在有氧能力、功能能力、肌肉力量和生活质量方面有效且可行。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children and adolescents with chronic diseases, the feasibility and effectiveness of extending exercise therapy to the home setting have been a focus. This systematic review clearly states that home-based physical exercise interventions effectively improve their aerobic capacity, function, muscle strength, and quality of life. This means you can more confidently recommend home exercise programs to parents to support the long-term rehabilitation of these children.
